name: Eliza Narsingway, the Mobile Stable Master companion, offers the stable (#11393)
contract: Mobile Stable Master (9931336) says 'Right Click to summon and dismiss Eliza Narsingway the mobile Stable Master.' and summons creature 10960 as a minipet; the core copies the template's npcflag onto the summon. The template carried npcflag 0 and gossip_menu_id 0, so HandleGossipHelloOpcode returned at once and a click did nothing.

Expected, from the stable masters the world already has (9896 World Stable Master, 24974 Liza Cutlerflix: npcflag 4194305 = gossip | stable master, gossip menu 9821 whose option 0 is 'I'd like to stable my pet here.'): a Primalist (class 31, which the core treats as a hunter for pets once Spirit Beast Master is learned) who clicks the companion is offered that menu (the stable option first, then the lost-companion entry), and the stable requests that need a stable master (CMSG_BUY_STABLE_SLOT) are accepted for it, answered with stable result 10.

steps.label: SETUP: Spirit Beast Master is known, so the Primalist counts as a hunter for pets
She offers the two options of menu 9821
and the first is the stable
